name: wnd_move_xy

name: status_draw_civ_color

name: sprite_editor_draw_backdrop

name: sprite_editor_cell_rect
evidence: Per sprite-sheet mode returns cell x/y/w/h for index param_1 and the sheet's cell count.

evidence: 1-based position of an item within its parent menu counting only items without hidden flag bit 2.

name: str_pipes_to_tabs
evidence: Replaces every '|' with a tab in place (menu text accelerator separator).

name: diplo_force_war

name: city_treasury_share

evidence: Picks (dialog for human, best ai_advance_value for AI) an advance victim param_2 has and gives it to param_1.

name: city_capture_aftermath

evidence: Plays an 8-frame sprite animation (00647168) at a tile across all visible map views with optional sound.

evidence: Plays sound 0x32 and an 11-frame mushroom-cloud sprite animation (00644b70) at a tile.

evidence: Selects a unit (via picker 005b6aea if stacked) from active unit or cursor tile, clears orders and focuses it.

name: unit_move_dir

name: spaceship_part_count

evidence: Sums spaceship_parts by group: 0 structurals, 1 components (1+2), else modules (3+4+5).

name: spaceship_launch

name: pedia_draw_improvement_page
evidence: Civilopedia improvement page: big icon, prerequisite link, cost and upkeep lines and description text.

name: pedia_show_improvement_modal
evidence: Opens Civilopedia on improvement param_1 (wonders via 00526913) and runs it modally.

name: net_session_clear
evidence: Zeroes many fields of the network session object then calls net_session_shutdown and net_reset_error_counts.

name: dlg_set_palette

name: dialog_edit_row_height

name: dialog_set_height
evidence: Stores field_1c; dialog_load_text_section calls it for the @HEIGHT directive.

name: dialog_set_option_draw_fn
evidence: Stores field_248 owner-draw callback that dialog option drawing calls (e.g. advance icon drawers).

name: dialog_select_option
evidence: Makes an option current, scrolls its pane into view, redraws and invokes the field_24c change callback.

name: int_clamp_b
evidence: Returns param_1 clamped to [param_2, param_3].

name: dialog_option_at_point
evidence: Hit-tests x,y against the current pane's list area; returns option index or negative edge/outside codes.

name: dialog_count_group_options
evidence: Counts option nodes whose group field (+0xc) equals param_1.

name: dialog_pick_pane_at
evidence: For two-pane dialogs (flag 0x400000) sets current pane field_48 by which pane rect contains the point.

name: dialog_draw_text_default_font
evidence: Forwards to the dialog text drawer 0059f3d7 (shadowed text, returns end x) using the dialog's own font field_8.

name: gfx_draw_vline
evidence: Builds a 1-pixel-wide rect x..x+1, y1..y2+1 and fills it; paired with gfx_draw_hline in frame-rect drawers.

name: pedia_draw_unit_page
evidence: Civilopedia page drawing unit sprite, prerequisite link, cost, attack/defense/HP/firepower/moves and flag text from PEDIA section.

evidence: Unit editor (006a4f88, unit sprites by field_2ec): copies the selected unit's working values into edit/combo controls.

evidence: Returns tile_zoc_unit_adjacent result only when the tile has no city.

evidence: Returns home city name pointer, or the NONE label when home_city is -1.

evidence: Returns land tile's territory civ if it differs from param civ and they have peace (bit 4) but no alliance, else -1.

name: surface_wnd_create
evidence: Creates frame window (005c5760), creates surface w,h, sets palette and installs the paint proc.

evidence: Returns window fields 84/88, used as upper clamp in wnd_resize_clamped.

evidence: Window rect height minus client rect height of a window record.

evidence: Mode 0x200 checks Ctrl, 0x100 Shift, 0x400 pumps messages and reports any WM_SYSKEY/SYSCHAR seen.

name: wnd_get_style_flags
evidence: Returns low 16 bits of the window object's field_0 creation flags (tested for 0x200).

evidence: Thin wrapper over surface_alloc_dib24 used by 24-bit BMP loaders.

evidence: Recreates surface DIB with 32-bit bitmap (005e45b5) and sets bpp code 4.

evidence: SetScrollRange on the control HWND then sets the position to the minimum.

evidence: Same as sprite_blit_to_surface but target is a DirectDraw surface locked with ddsurf_lock and using ddsurf pitch/height.

name: gfx_scale_length
evidence: Maps a pixel length/offset through cumulative scale table iptr_006e47c8 using zoom ratio DAT_00637f98/9c, preserving sign.

evidence: SendMessageA(hwnd, EM_LINELENGTH=0xC1, index, 0).

evidence: MessageBox "Sound Error" with "This Sound format is not supported" for code 10 or "Undefined Sound Error" otherwise.

evidence: waveOutGetErrorTextA then MessageBox titled "Wave Out Error".

evidence: UnmapViewOfFile on field 0x90 and CloseHandle on mapping handle 0x94; used by file_obj_unmap_view.

name: diffeng_apply_image

name: diffeng_section_init
evidence: Sets DiffEngSection data_ptr, size, id, zero checksum and dword-padded size.
